'''Jagomiri swamp stalkers''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[vulpine]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jagomir]].<ref name="OAA1" /> When the [[Ardan resistance]] arrived on Jagomir, many rebel patrols had to fight off various swamp stalkers.
